description: Same as straight_5m_then_left_door_direct, but the straight is 3 m. WHY: every pose of door_runup_left_5m.json puts the doorway 5 m ahead and 2 m to the left, so after 5 m the car stands ON the door axis, perpendicular to it, 2 m from the opening: a forward left turn (Dubins rho = 1.1 x R_min ~ 1.06 m) ends 1.06 m past the axis, and EnterDoor answers door_needs_steered_reverse without moving (HIL smoke 20261123_174535, both 5 m missions). Stopping 2 m before the axis leaves ~0.9 m of straight, the 90 deg left turn and ~0.9 m into the opening. The turn may start no later than ~3.9 m.
